own_solution.law: omega^2 = g k + sigma k^3/rho (deep water); v_g = (g + 3 sigma k^2/rho)/(2 omega)
assumptions: deep water, small amplitude, negligible viscosity

defect_reasons.other: T9415 ('had reduced the surface tension of the water ... before the ripples were made') does not name the tank, and the pluperfect allows the reading that the stated 0.0728 N/m already includes the reduction, which would make it D rather than R.

notes: Base answer 0.185891 m/s and R answer 0.17134 m/s at 0.015 N/m match my pass-1 values. Minimal pairs hold: TB5C8/T1028 differ only in which vessel (bowl vs tank), and TC5E1/T9415 only in timing (earlier run vs before these ripples), all at 0.015 N/m. T6703 and T14D0 are declared numeral-free controls. The ambiguity is in the wording only: under the intended reading, and the more natural one, the physics and the claims hold.
